d: In a major boost to India's maritime surveillance and coastal defence capabilities, the Cabinet Committee on Security approved a project worth ₹40,000 crore to induct eight next generation corvettes in the Indian Navy. The government is set to sign contracts with Kolkata based Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers (GRSE) and Goa Shipyard Limited (GSL) for their construction. The Indian navy is expected to receive the first of the eight warships by 2030 with shipyards exploring ways to expedite construction and advance delivery timelines.
